## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Separate automated evidence from live gameplay; include backend, Minecraft, and model versions for live checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and relevant documentation agree with the final change.
- [ ] Inputs, cancellation, manual handoff, and partial progress are handled where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, runtime state, worlds, downloaded dependencies, or generated bundles are committed.
- [ ] Required checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass, or a specific limitation is explained above.
